entities.name: Rauni Magga Lukkari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rauni Magga Lukkari is a Sámi poet and translator. Although she was born in Vetsikko, Utsjoki, Finland in 1943, she has lived in Tromsø, Norway since 1980. Lukkari writes in Northern Sami.
